title: Solution Architect
description:
**Solution Architect**

*Azure Cloud & DevOps Practice | Enterprise Platform Engineering | Solution Architecture*

**Total Experience:** 10+ years (software development + cloud/DevOps + architecture)

**Relevant Experience:** 8 years in cloud/DevSecOps; 4+ years as Application/Solution Architect

**Primary Cloud Platform:** Microsoft Azure

**Additional Platforms:** AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

**Engagement Type:** Enterprise production, multi-region, regulated environments; pre-sales & discovery

**Required Certification:**

* Azure Solutions Architect Expert or AWS Solution Architect (must);

**ABOUT THE ROLE & ORGANISATION**

Together with our client, we are building an enterprise-grade Azure platform that supports critical business operations where reliability, security, and delivery speed directly impact outcomes.

The DevOps team owns the infrastructure lifecycle, including IaC, CI/CD, Kubernetes, observability, and close collaboration with development, security, and operations teams.

**KEY SKILLS & TECHNOLOGY STACK**

**Category**

**Technologies / Tools**

**Cloud Platforms**

Microsoft Azure (primary), AWS, GCP

  

**Azure Services**

AKS, API Management, Application Gateway, Front Door, VNet, Private Link, Key Vault, Service Bus, Event Hub, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics

  

**Dev Languages**

Python, .NET (C#), Java, Node.js

  

**Architecture Styles**

Microservices, SOA, Event-Driven, CQRS, Serverless, Domain-Driven Design

  

**IaC & Automation**

Terraform (modular, remote state, env separation), Bash, PowerShell, Python

  

**CI/CD**

GitLab CI/CD (pipelines, runners, registries, reusable templates), Azure DevOps, Jenkins

  

**Containers & K8s**

AKS, Helm, Docker, Service Mesh: Istio/Linkerd (advantage), GitOps: ArgoCD/Flux

  

**Observability**

Dynatrace (full-stack, tracing, dashboards, alerting), Azure Monitor, Log Analytics

  

**Security & Identity**

Entra ID, RBAC, Managed Identities, Key Vault, Azure Policy, Defender for Cloud, NSG, Private Endpoints

  

**Vulnerability Mgmt**

Qualys, cloud compliance & posture management tooling

  

**Networking**

VNet, Subnets, NSG, DNS, Load Balancing, Private Endpoints, Application Gateway, Front Door

  

**FinOps & Pre-Sales**

Cloud cost optimization, rightsizing, estimation, scope decomposition, proposal preparation

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Solution Architecture & Pre-Sales**

* Lead discovery, client workshops, proposal input, estimation, scope decomposition, risk assessment, and architecture documentation.
* Design scalable solutions across Azure-first, multi-cloud, microservices, event-driven, serverless, and domain-driven architecture patterns.
* Create prototypes, proofs of concept, technical specifications, architecture diagrams, risk registers, and system requirements.
* Guide implementation, evaluate technology options, support decision-making, and transfer knowledge to engineering teams.
* Partner with customer, business, product, security, operations, and engineering stakeholders throughout delivery.

**Leadership & Team Development**

* Lead and mentor engineers and technical leads while establishing engineering standards, ownership, and continuous improvement practices.
* Improve developer experience through practical documentation, reusable patterns, and collaboration across engineering, product, and business teams.
* Contribute to cloud architecture practices and community knowledge sharing.

**Cloud Architecture & Platform Ownership**

* Own the Azure cloud and DevOps architecture roadmap, standards, and reusable reference patterns.
* Design Terraform-based, environment-separated, production-grade, multi-region infrastructure.
* Architect and govern core Azure services including AKS, API Management, Application Gateway, Front Door, VNet, Private Link, Key Vault, Service Bus, and Event Hub.
* Standardize configuration, environment parity, cost optimization, and reliability across production, staging, and development.

**CI/CD & Delivery Engineering**

* Build and improve GitLab CI/CD and Azure DevOps pipelines, reusable templates, runners, registries, and multi-environment deployments.
* Integrate security controls such as SAST, secret scanning, and container image scanning into delivery workflows.
* Implement auditable Kubernetes delivery using appropriate CI/CD tooling.

**Kubernetes & Container Platform**

* Manage AKS clusters and containerized workloads - from ingress configuration and autoscaling to service mesh adoption.
* Maintain Helm chart libraries and containers build pipelines for multi-environment application delivery.
* Investigate and remediate Kubernetes infrastructure issues; perform root-cause analysis and implement scalable long-term fixes.

**Observability & Reliability**

* Drive observability with Dynatrace, Azure Monitor, and Log Analytics, including tracing, dashboards, SLOs, alerts, and error budgets.
* Lead incident management, on-call triage, root-cause analysis, and post-incident reviews.
* Improve reliability and deployment efficiency through proactive monitoring and automated remediation.
  

**Security & Compliance (DevSecOps)**

* Embed DevSecOps controls across secrets, identity, RBAC, network policies, and cloud governance.
* Manage security posture using Entra ID, Managed Identities, Azure Policy, Defender for Cloud, NSG, Private Endpoints, and Key Vault.
* Support vulnerability remediation, public-access findings, and regulatory compliance using Qualys and related platforms.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

**Experience & Background**

* **10+ years of technology experience across software development, cloud infrastructure, DevOps, and solution architecture.**
* 5+ years in DevOps, Cloud, or SRE roles, including at least 2 years in a lead or architect capacity.
* Experience in application or solution architecture, pre-sales, proposal input, estimation, scope decomposition, and client workshops.
* Readiness for business travel up to 4 weeks per year.

**Cloud & Infrastructure**

* Strong Azure experience across AKS, API Management, Application Gateway, Front Door, VNet, Private Link, Key Vault, Service Bus, Event Hub, Entra ID, RBAC, Managed Identities, Azure Policy, and Defender for Cloud.
* Working knowledge of AWS and GCP for multi-cloud design and evaluation.
* Proficiency in Terraform, Kubernetes on AKS, Helm, containers, and cloud networking including subnets, NSG, DNS, Private Endpoints, and load balancing.

**Software Development & Architecture**

* 10+ years of hands-on development using Python, .NET/C#, Java, Node.js, or comparable modern stacks.
* Deep knowledge of SOA, microservices, event-driven, CQRS, serverless, and domain-driven design patterns.
* Skilled in scalable system design, quality attributes, technical drivers, design patterns, and architecture documentation.

**CI/CD, Observability & Security**

* GitLab CI/CD end-to-end: pipelines, runners, environments, container registries, and reusable pipeline templates.
* Proficiency in scripting with Bash, PowerShell, or Python.
* Strong troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and production support skills in enterprise, multi-region environments.

**Soft Skills & Communication**

* Strong leadership, stakeholder management, customer engagement, and presentation skills.
* Ability to collaborate across teams without direct reporting lines.
* Upper-intermediate English or above; comfortable presenting to multidisciplinary audiences.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* FinOps experience: cloud cost optimization, resource rightsizing, reserved capacity planning.
* Familiarity with different CI/CD tools.
* Experience with Dynatrace or similar APM and full-stack observability platforms.
* Experience with Qualys or similar vulnerability management platforms.
* Exposure to regulated or financial services environments.
* Knowledge of service mesh technologies (Istio, Linkerd).
* Familiarity with Azure DevOps pipelines (complementary to GitLab CI/CD).
* Graduate or postgraduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent.
* Experience supporting global, cross-functional operational teams across multiple time zones.

**CERTIFICATIONS**

**Strongly Recommended**

* **AZ-305 - Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect Expert (highly aligned with SA responsibilities)**
* Or
* AWS Solutions Architect Associate or Professional

**Advantageous**

* HashiCorp Terraform Associate or Professional
* GitLab Certified CI/CD Associate or Professional

title: Integration Architect
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Configure-Price-Quote (CPQ) Business Process Owner

We are seeking an experienced Integration Architect with a strong foundation in **full-stack development, specializing in .NET backend technologies and Microsoft Azure**. The ideal candidate will design scalable and secure solutions while providing technical leadership and aligning architectural strategy with business goals. Guides cross-functional teams through architectural decisions, ensuring technical excellence and innovation.

The preferred Working Model: Hybrid / Remote.

**You will be mainly accountable for:**

* **Solution Architecture:** Design practical, scalable, and secure solutions using .NET and Microsoft Azure that meet business and product needs.
* **Integration & APIs:** Design and guide integrations between applications, APIs, internal systems, and external solutions to ensure smooth and reliable connectivity.
* **Technical Guidance:** Provide technical guidance to development teams across .NET, front-end, database, and cloud technologies, helping teams make sound technical decisions.
* **Azure Solutions:** Design and improve Azure-based solutions with a focus on performance, reliability, security, scalability, and cost effectiveness.
* **DevOps & Engineering Practices:** Support good engineering practices including CI/CD, containerization, infrastructure as code, coding standards, and technical documentation.
* **Architecture & Security Standards:** Ensure solutions follow relevant architecture, security, data privacy, and development standards while keeping governance practical and effective.
* **Cross-Team Collaboration:** Work closely with internal teams and external partners to manage technical dependencies, address challenges, and support successful delivery.
* **Stakeholder Partnership:** Collaborate with Product Owners, business stakeholders, UX, and engineering teams to turn business requirements into effective technical solutions and support the long-term product vision.

**Qualifications for the role:**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Around 7+ years of relevant experience in software development, solution architecture, integration architecture, or technical leadership within enterprise environments.
* Strong experience with C#/.NET, ASP.NET Core, Microsoft Azure, and designing modern, scalable applications and APIs.
* Good understanding of system integrations, microservices, event-driven architecture, databases, and modern front-end technologies such as React, Angular, or Vue.js.
* Familiarity with DevOps and cloud engineering practices, including CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes/AKS, and infrastructure as code; experience modernizing existing or legacy applications is an advantage.
* Strong communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work effectively with Product Owners, development teams, business stakeholders, and external partners in a global environment.
* Knowledge of Salesforce CPQ / CLM are preferred.

You don’t need to meet every requirement to apply. If you have .NET and Azure experience and enjoy designing solutions and collaborating across teams, we encourage you to apply.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Recruitment Fraud Warning

ABB never asks for payment from job applicants. All genuine job offers follow a formal application and interview process.

View current job openings and apply at: https://careers.abb/global/en/home

For more information, read our full fraud warning notice at: https://global.abb/group/en/careers/how-to-apply/fraud-warning

title: Hardware Design and Development Engineer
description:
Position Summary

Innospace Automation Services Pvt. Ltd. is looking for a Hardware Design & Development Engineer to contribute to the design, development, testing and validation of electronic hardware for industrial automation and embedded products. The role includes circuit design, component selection, prototype bring-up, troubleshooting and supporting products from concept through manufacturing.

Key Responsibilities

· Work with the technical and engineering teams to understand hardware requirements and product architecture.

· Design and develop analog and digital electronic circuits for industrial and embedded applications.

· Select suitable electronic components based on performance, reliability, lifecycle, availability and cost.

· Develop hardware interfaces for microcontrollers and embedded platforms such as STM32, dsPIC33, PIC18, ESP32, ARM Cortex and NXP i.MX, as relevant to the project.

· Work with interfaces and peripherals such as SPI, I2C, UART, CAN, LIN, RS485, RS232, Ethernet, USB, SD Card, ADC, DAC and PWM.

· Support power-supply design and evaluation, including AC-DC, DC-DC, Buck, Boost, LDO and battery-charger circuits, as required.

· Assemble and bring up prototypes; test, debug and validate hardware using laboratory equipment.

· Use tools such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, spectrum analyzers, multimeters, power supplies and electronic loads to investigate issues.

· Troubleshoot hardware faults, analyze performance data and recommend design corrections or improvements.

· Collaborate with PCB design and software teams to ensure hardware compatibility and integration.

· Support prototype validation, manufacturing handover, repairs/modifications and engineering change activities.

· Maintain hardware design documents, BOMs, test reports and other engineering records.

Required Skills

· Strong fundamentals in analog and digital electronics.

· Understanding of microcontrollers, sensors, connectors, isolators, MOSFETs, op-amps, ADCs and DACs.

· Ability to test, debug and troubleshoot electronic circuits and prototypes.

· Working knowledge of schematic and PCB design tools such as Altium Designer, KiCad or similar.

· Structured problem-solving, attention to detail and the ability to work collaboratively.

Preferred Domain Knowledge

· Industrial Automation and Machine Automation

· Industrial IoT and wireless communication

· Energy monitoring and crane automation

· Embedded product development

Products / Projects

· UNIBUS Platform

· CraneIQ Pro

· Industrial IoT Gateways

· Wireless IO Systems

· CAN-based Products

· Industrial Radio Remote Controls

Personal Attributes

· Analytical thinking and problem-solving

· Ownership mindset and attention to detail

· Teamwork and willingness to learn

Career Growth

Hardware Design & Development Engineer → Senior Hardware Engineer → Lead Hardware Engineer → Technical Architect → R&D Manager

Compensation

To be finalized based on experience, technical assessment and the approved salary range.

Pay: ₹200,000.00 - ₹400,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: FBS SR Solutions Engineer (Guidewire)
description:

By combining international reach with US expertise, we build diverse and high-performing teams that are equipped to thrive in today’s competitive marketplace.

We believe that the foundation of every successful business lies in having the right people with the right skills. That is where we come in—helping Farmers build a winning team that delivers consistent and sustainable results.

Since we don’t have a local legal entity, we’ve partnered with Capgemini, which acts as the Employer of Record. Capgemini is responsible for managing local payroll and benefits.

**What to expect on your journey with us:**

* A solid and innovative company with a strong market presence
* A dynamic, diverse, and multicultural work environment
* Leaders with deep market knowledge and strategic vision
* Continuous learning and development

This position collaborates with business stakeholders, solution engineers, architects and Agile teams to deliver Guidewire configuration and integration solutions that support complex insurance initiatives. The role serves as a subject matter resource for the Guidewire platform, providing system level perspectives and implementing technical solutions aligned with business and architectural objectives.

Key Responsibilities

* Optimizing Guidewire configuration, building reliable integrations using APIs and messaging frameworks
* Improving development and deployment processes through CI/CD and DevOps practices.
* Ensures successful technology delivery across lines of business and the enterprise
* Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and version control systems.

title: Connect Account Manager
description:
**AVEVA is creating software trusted by over 90% of leading industrial companies.**

As an integral part of this CONNECT commercial team, you won’t just sell—you’ll help define how we bring this platform to market. This role goes beyond achieving sales targets; it's about building long-term customer value, expanding product adoption, and accelerating AVEVA’s next wave of growth. **Key Responsibilities**

* Inform commercial model, onboarding approaches, and playbooks for future scale

* Strong sales acumen, including territory planning, value-based selling, stakeholder mapping, and negotiation

title: Specialist Technical Support Engineer (AI Solutions)
description:

**So, what's the role all about?**

As a Specialist Advanced Engineering Technical Support Engineer, you will provide senior-level L2/L3 engineering support for AI-powered solutions in production environments. This role combines deep troubleshooting expertise with software engineering capabilities, supporting agentic AI applications, cloud infrastructure, APIs, data platforms, and automation frameworks.

You will be responsible for diagnosing complex incidents, performing root-cause analysis, implementing code-level fixes, improving platform reliability, and partnering with architects, developers, and business stakeholders to ensure high availability and performance of critical AI solutions.

* Own and resolve complex P1/P2 incidents across agentic AI, cloud, data, and application layers.

* Analyze Snowflake and AWS environments to identify performance, security, data, and integration issues.

* Monitor system health using observability and LLMOps tools, proactively identifying reliability risks.
* Support automation frameworks, event-driven workflows, and data pipelines to ensure consistent operations.
* Improve operational maturity through runbooks, alerts, knowledge articles, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Collaborate with engineering, architecture, product, and business teams to drive successful AI solution adoption.

* Strong understanding of Snowflake data platform, query optimization, security controls, and data operations.

* Knowledge of observability tools, logging, monitoring, tracing, and incident management.

Join an innovative, fast-growing team building next-generation AI-powered solutions that directly impact business operations. title: Senior Staff Solution Architect
description:
**Company Description**

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

 **Job Description**

ServiceNow is seeking a Sr Staff Solution Architect to lead the design and delivery of scalable, intelligent, and high-impact solutions across the Connected Customer Experience portfolio. This is a senior-level, hands-on architecture role focused on enabling seamless digital workflows, integrating platform capabilities with AI/ML and data-driven insights, and ensuring technical excellence across customer-facing applications.

You will work at the intersection of product, engineering, platform, data, and AI teams to architect solutions that enhance user experience, deliver personalized customer journeys, and drive measurable business outcomes. The ideal candidate has deep expertise in enterprise SaaS architecture, CRM systems, solution design, AI/ML integration, and data platform engineering within Digital Technology (DT) environments.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Solution Architecture & Design**

* Architect scalable, secure, and compliant end-to-end solutions integrating platform capabilities with intelligent data-driven features across customer experience applications.
* Define architecture patterns for workflows, integrations, platform extensions, and API-driven services that extend ServiceNow capabilities while ensuring alignment with security and platform standards.
* Lead evolution of architectural standards, evaluate tools and frameworks, and partner with product and engineering leaders to translate business requirements into technical designs.

**AI/ML & Data Platform**

* Architect AI/ML capabilities for personalization, recommendations, semantic search, and conversational AI with service layers that enable easy consumption by product teams.
* Design unified data architecture bringing together customer signals across touchpoints, including data lakes, warehouses, real-time pipelines, and analytical products.
* Establish governance frameworks for data quality, privacy, security, and compliance (GDPR, CCPA) while ensuring data readiness and pipeline integration.
* Define architecture for model observability, performance monitoring, and continuous learning feedback loops.

**Technical Strategy & Leadership**

* Define multi-year architectural roadmaps and lead architectural reviews, governance processes, and critical modeling decisions across product verticals.
* Translate complex designs into accessible, secure services ensuring observability, performance, and operational excellence while mentoring architects and senior engineers.
* Provide thought leadership on emerging technologies and foster a culture of technical excellence.

  
**Qualifications**

**To be successful in this role you have**

* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
* 15+ years in enterprise software architecture, solution design, or technical leadership with significant CRM and enterprise SaaS platform experience.
* Proven track record designing production-grade solutions across customer service, digital workflows, CRM, or customer experience platforms.
* Deep expertise in microservices, event-driven architectures, API-first design, cloud-native technologies, and security best practices.
* Strong understanding of AI/ML systems with hands-on experience in personalization, NLP/NLU, semantic search, or conversational AI.
* Experience with data platform architecture including data modeling, ETL/ELT pipelines, streaming, data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks), and data governance.
* Familiarity with ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Hugging Face), MLOps tools, and data processing tools (Spark, dbt, Airflow).
* Excellent communication skills with ability to influence stakeholders across cross-functional, matrixed global organizations.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with ServiceNow platform and extending its capabilities through custom applications or intelligent services.
* Deep understanding of CRM platforms (Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, ServiceNow CSM) and their integration with customer experience ecosystems.
* Background in customer journey orchestration, personalized digital experiences, or recommendation engines in large-scale SaaS environments.
* Hands-on experience with LLM integration, prompt engineering, RAG, and vector databases for GenAI applications.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and experience in global, matrixed organizations.

**What We Offer**

* A high-impact role shaping customer experience architecture within one of the world's leading enterprise platforms.
* The opportunity to define architectural strategies for mission-critical applications serving millions of users.
* A collaborative, innovation-focused culture with organizational influence and visibility to senior leadership.

title: Chief Architect - India
description:
**All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.**

### **About JumpCloud®**

JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.

### **JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.**

### **About the Role**

We are seeking a visionary, disruptive, and highly agile **Chief Architect** to define and drive the next generation of our platform’s architecture. Reporting directly to the Head of Engineering, you will be our primary AI evangelist, challenging the status quo and seamlessly embedding evolving AI capabilities into our core systems.

Operating in the dynamic Identity, Access Management, and Device Management space you will architect high-scale solutions, conduct deep competitive analysis, and provide strategic technical guidance to leadership. As a deeply experienced technologist and a natural mentor, you will inspire our engineering teams, ensuring we remain nimble, innovative, and ahead of the curve in a rapidly changing technological landscape.

### **Key Responsibilities:**

* **Architectural Disruption & Design:** Continuously evaluate our existing platform architecture and suggest/implement transformative design changes to leverage the latest advancements in AI.
* **AI Evangelism & Strategy:** Act as the internal and external champion for AI. Challenge legacy mindsets, drive a culture of disruptive innovation, and articulate a clear AI vision that aligns with our business goals in the Identity space.
* **Technical Leadership & Guidance:** Serve as the trusted advisor and strategic partner to the Head of Engineering and executive leadership, translating complex AI developments into actionable product and engineering strategies.
* **Scale & Performance:** Architect robust, scalable, and secure AI-driven systems capable of handling massive data volumes and high-traffic identity workflows globally.
* **Mentorship & Team Building:** Be a force multiplier for our technical teams. Provide hands-on mentorship, foster a culture of continuous learning, and elevate the technical capabilities of individual contributors and engineering managers.
* **Competitive Analysis & Market Positioning:** Keep a pulse on the rapidly evolving AI and Identity/Directory-as-a-Service markets. Conduct deep technical competitive analyses to ensure our architecture and AI features outpace industry rivals.
* **Agile Adaptation:** Maintain a nimble approach to architecture. Pivot and adapt technical strategies quickly as new AI models, frameworks, and security requirements emerge.

### **Required Qualifications:**

* **Deep AI Expertise:** 15+ years of software engineering/architecture experience with at least 4+ years dedicated to deep AI integrations.
* **Domain Expertise in Identity Space:** Proven experience in the Identity and Access Management (IAM), Directory-as-a-Service (DaaS), Zero Trust, or endpoint management domains (comparable to JumpCloud, Okta, Ping Identity, etc.).
* **Massive Scale Experience:** A strong track record of designing, building, and maintaining distributed cloud architectures and data pipelines that operate reliably at massive scale.
* **Disruptive & Nimble Mindset:** Demonstrated ability to be an "agent of change." You are highly adaptable, agile, and comfortable pivoting architectures to adopt cutting-edge technologies.
* **Exceptional Mentorship & Leadership:** Proven experience elevating the teams around you. You are known as a technical leader who leads by influence, coaches individual engineers, and upskills entire organizations.
* **Executive Communication:** The ability to distill highly complex technical concepts into clear, strategic guidance for the Head of Engineering and C-suite leadership.
* **Analytical Prowess:** Strong capability to dissect competitors' products, anticipate industry trends, and translate those insights into architectural advantages.

You will serve as the deep technical expert, translating complex customer needs into robust, scalable, and automated Observability solutions.

In this role, you will bridge the gap between our product capabilities and the customer's modern, often cloud-native, application and infrastructure environments. You will architect solutions that leverage Platform Engineering best practices, integrating New Relic seamlessly into their CI/CD pipelines, automation frameworks, and internal developer platforms to drive wall-to-wall observability. * **Platform Integration & Automation:** Design and implement automated deployment and configuration solutions for New Relic using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools (e.g., Terraform, Ansible) and scripting (e.g., Python, Go, Shell). Deeply integrate Observability into customer's Platform Engineering and CI/CD workflows (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab, GitHub Actions).
* **Technical Leadership:** Serve as the subject matter expert on Observability concepts, APM, Infrastructure Monitoring, and Log Management. Lead technical workshops and design sessions with customer architects, engineers, and leadership to define the implementation roadmap.
* **Troubleshooting and Optimization:** Provide advanced technical guidance during initial deployments and optimization phases, addressing complex data ingestion, performance, and platform configuration challenges.
* **Knowledge Transfer & Best Practices:** Create and deliver technical documentation, blueprints, and training to enable customer Platform teams and internal Professional Services/Partner resources to confidently manage and extend the implemented solution.

**Your Qualifications**

We believe that experience comes in many forms and are dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive team. If you believe you have the skills to be successful in this role, we encourage you to apply.

* **Platform Engineering Mastery:** Proven, extensive experience with core Platform Engineering concepts, including building and maintaining automated, self-service infrastructure and delivery pipelines.
* **Automation and DevOps Proficiency:** Deep expertise in **Automation, Scripting (e.g., Python), and CI/CD** practices and tools. Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) is highly valued.
* **Observability Expertise:** Exceptional knowledge and practical experience with **Observability concepts (The Three Pillars) and products (New Relic, Datadog, Dynatrace, etc.)** is **extremely important**. You can articulate the 'why' and 'how' of Observability to technical and non-technical audiences.
* **Cloud Proficiency:** Hands-on experience designing and deploying solutions on major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* **Consultative Influence:** Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to influence senior technical stakeholders and drive consensus on complex technical architectures.

title: Senior ServiceNow Solution Architect - ITOM & CSDM
description:
Pragma Technologies is an innovative IT company specializing in consulting and technology services across the German-speaking region (DACH). With a team of around 50 dedicated professionals, we deliver modern digital solutions and help organizations transform their processes, platforms, and technology landscapes. We are headquartered in Hamburg, Germany and Lucerne, Switzerland.

We are looking for an experienced ServiceNow Solution Architect with a strong development background and deep expertise in ITOM, CMDB, CSDM, and NowAssist to join our growing offshore delivery team based in India.

**Tasks**
---------

As a ServiceNow Solution Architect, you will be a key technical driver in our offshore team. You will design, develop, and deliver robust ServiceNow solutions for enterprise clients across the DACH region — working independently and collaboratively with our onshore consultants in Germany and Switzerland. You will be responsible for both architectural decisions and hands-on development. Design and develop complex ServiceNow solutions with a focus on ITOM, CMDB, and CSDM 5.0 alignment.

**Project Leadership & Autonomy**

* Take full ownership of ServiceNow workstreams - plan, prioritize, and drive delivery independently with minimal supervision
* Lead projects end-to-end: from initial scoping and solution design through to go-live and handover
* Act as the primary technical point of contact for assigned clients, managing expectations and communicating progress proactively
* Coordinate with developers, consultants, and client teams to ensure on-time, on-quality delivery
* Identify risks early, propose mitigation strategies, and escalate when necessary

**Presentations & Client Communication**

* Prepare and deliver structured presentations to senior client stakeholders — including architecture overviews, sprint reviews, and solution demonstrations
* Present complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
* Create high-quality documentation and deliverables: solution designs, architecture diagrams, and implementation reports
* Represent Pragma Technologies professionally in client-facing situations — written and spoken English required at all times

**Presales Activities**

* Support presales processes by contributing technical input to proposals, RFP responses, and solution concepts
* Conduct discovery calls and technical assessment sessions with prospective clients
* Estimate effort, define scope, and propose solution approaches for new opportunities
* Develop reusable presales assets such as solution templates, demo environments, and capability decks

**Process Workshops**

* Plan and facilitate process workshops with client stakeholders to capture requirements and define target architectures
* Lead CMDB scoping workshops: define CI classes, discovery scope, data ownership, and governance rules
* Run CSDM alignment workshops to map business services, technical services, and application portfolios
* Document workshop outcomes as structured decision logs, process flows, and solution blueprints
* Drive stakeholder alignment across IT, business, and management levels during workshops

**Technical Delivery**

* Design and develop complex ServiceNow solutions with a focus on ITOM, CMDB, and CSDM 5.0 alignment
* Lead and execute Discovery configurations and troubleshooting (patterns, MID Server, credentials, probes/sensors)
* Architect and maintain a healthy, well-structured CMDB including IRE, normalization, deduplication, and CMDB Health dashboards
* Implement and govern CSDM 5.0 data models — mapping Business Services, Technical Services, Application Services, and supporting CIs
* Configure and extend NowAssist (AI features) including Now Intelligence, Predictive Intelligence, and Virtual Agent flows
* Develop advanced platform customizations: Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Policies, Flow Designer, and REST/SOAP integrations
* Perform code reviews and enforce ServiceNow development best practices — minimizing unnecessary customizations
* Document solution designs, architecture decisions, and implementation guides

**Requirements**
----------------

**Certifications**

* Certified System Administrator (CSA) – mandatory
* Certified Application Developer (CAD) – mandatory
* CIS-ITSM – mandatory
* CIS-Discovery – mandatory
* CIS-DF (CMDB & CSDM) – scheduled/mandatory or demonstrable equivalent expertise
* Additional certifications (CIS-Service Mapping, ITIL) are a strong plus

**Technical Expertise**

* Expert-level scripting (JavaScript/GlideScript), Flow Designer, REST APIs, Integration Hub, App Engine ServiceNow Development
* Hands-on experience with Discovery (patterns, schedules, MID Server, credentials), Service Mapping, Event Management, and Operational Intelligence ITOM
* Deep knowledge of CMDB architecture, IRE (Identification & Reconciliation Engine), CMDB Data Manager, Service Graph Connectors, deduplication strategies, and CMDB 360
* Strong familiarity with CSDM 5.0 framework — Business Applications, Technical Services, Application Services, Hosted On relationships, and lifecycle management
* Practical experience configuring NowAssist, Predictive Intelligence, or Virtual Agent — AI-powered workflows and case deflection use cases NowAssist / AI
* Experience with REST/SOAP integrations, Integration Hub spokes, and third-party connectors Integration
* CMDB Health configuration, ATF (Automated Testing Framework), and instance performance best practices Performance & Health

**Language Requirements**

* English: Fluent (written and spoken) - required for daily client and team communication
* Hindi: Fluent - required for internal team collaboration

**Nice to Have**

* Exposure to Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM) modules
* Experience with DACH-region enterprise clients or German-speaking stakeholders
* Experience in a subcontracting or offshore delivery model

**Soft Skills We Value**

* Highly self-driven and autonomous - you take ownership of your work and deliver without being micromanaged
* Natural leader - comfortable running workshops, steering project meetings, and keeping teams aligned
* Confident presenter - you can hold a room and explain technical solutions to executives and IT teams alike
* Strong analytical thinker - you systematically diagnose complex issues and communicate findings clearly
* Reliable communicator across time zones - proactive status updates, clean documentation, no surprises
* Culturally adaptable - experienced in working with European enterprise clients and DACH business culture
* Continuous learner - you stay current with ServiceNow releases and proactively develop new competencies

**Benefits**
------------

* Fully remote position based in India with flexible working hours
* Sponsored trip to Switzerland for an in-person workation with the core team - fully covered
* Long-term engagement with a stable, growing company in the DACH region
* Exposure to high-quality enterprise projects across Switzerland and Germany
* Access to ServiceNow learning resources and certification support
* Collaborative team culture
* Fair compensation aligned with your expertise and contribution

**How to Apply**

If you are passionate about ServiceNow, have a strong development background, and thrive in a technically challenging environment - we would love to hear from you.

Please send your CV, ServiceNow certifications, and a brief summary of your most relevant ITOM/CMDB/CSDM experience.

Applications in English only, please.

title: AI/ML Expert
description:
Job Description – AI/ML Expert

Position Overview

We are seeking experienced AI/ML professionals from India to join our technology team

in Malaysia. This opportunity is ideal for accomplished AI/ML engineers, data scientists,

machine learning specialists, and applied AI professionals with 5–10 years of relevant

experience who are interested in working on enterprise-grade AI solutions and

contributing to the development of intelligent, scalable, and data-driven applications.

The selected candidate will work closely with engineering, product, data, and business

teams to identify opportunities for applying Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to

real-world business challenges.

The exact designation may be aligned with the candidate’s expertise and experience, such

as AI/ML Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer, AI Engineer, Data Scientist, Applied AI

Engineer, or Senior AI/ML Specialist.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, develop, implement, and maintain AI and Machine Learning solutions for

business and technology use cases.

* Analyze complex business problems and translate them into suitable AI/ML

approaches.

* Develop and optimize machine learning models using appropriate algorithms,

frameworks, and techniques.

* Work with structured and unstructured datasets to identify patterns, trends, and

actionable insights.

* Perform data preparation, feature engineering, model training, validation,

evaluation, and optimization.

* Develop production-ready AI/ML pipelines and integrate models into enterprise

applications and platforms.

* Apply techniques such as supervised and unsupervised learning, deep learning,

natural language processing, computer vision, recommendation systems,

forecasting, and predictive analytics, depending on project requirements.

* Explore and implement modern Generative AI and Large Language Model (LLM)

technologies where relevant.

* Develop solutions involving LLMs, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector

databases, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, and model

orchestration, where applicable.

* Evaluate emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and models and recommend

appropriate solutions.

* Collaborate with software engineers to deploy AI/ML models into production

environments.

* Monitor model performance, accuracy, scalability, reliability, and data quality after

deployment.

* Identify opportunities to improve model performance through experimentation,

tuning, and continuous learning.

* Design and implement appropriate approaches for model explainability, security,

privacy, and responsible AI.

* Participate in architecture discussions and contribute to the design of scalable AI-

enabled applications.

* Work with cloud platforms and modern MLOps practices for model deployment and

lifecycle management.

* Prepare technical documentation covering models, methodologies, architectures,

experiments, and deployment processes.

* Mentor junior engineers/data scientists and contribute to the development of AI/ML

engineering best practices.

* Stay current with developments in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Deep

Learning, Generative AI, LLMs, and MLOps.

Required Technical Skills

Candidates should have strong practical experience in several of the following areas:

Programming & Data

* Strong proficiency in Python.
* Experience with SQL and relational/non-relational databases.
* Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, statistics, and data analysis.
* Experience with libraries/frameworks such as NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn,

TensorFlow, PyTorch, or equivalent.

Machine Learning

* Strong understanding of machine learning concepts and algorithms.
* Experience with model development, training, validation, evaluation, and

optimization.

* Hands-on experience with regression, classification, clustering, recommendation,

forecasting, or other relevant ML techniques.

* Knowledge of feature engineering, model selection, hyperparameter optimization,

and performance evaluation.

Deep Learning / AI

Experience in one or more of:

* Neural networks and deep learning.
* Natural Language Processing (NLP).
* Computer Vision.
* Speech/Audio AI.
* Time-series analysis.
* Recommendation systems.
* Predictive analytics.
* Generative AI.

Generative AI / LLM

Exposure to or hands-on experience with:

* Large Language Models (LLMs).

title: Senior Principal - P&C Platform Engineer
description:
Business Introduction  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

Build, automate and run the platform that 50,000+ employees across [X] countries use to communicate and collaborate — Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online and OneDrive, Exchange Online, the Microsoft 365 apps, Power Platform and Microsoft 365 Copilot.

This is the hands-on build role. The Platform Engineer takes architecture direction and a prioritised backlog and turns them into working, tested, automated, documented configuration in production. The expectation is engineering rather than administration: configuration expressed as code and deployed through pipelines, not clicked through a portal and remembered by whoever was on shift.

The role also runs what it builds. Platform Engineers own the operational health of their workloads — diagnosing the awkward, intermittent, only-happens-in-Tokyo problems that never reproduce in a lab, and eliminating the root cause rather than closing the ticket.

**Key Responsibilities**

  
* Design, build, test and deploy configuration across the Microsoft 365 estate: Teams policies, SharePoint and OneDrive settings, Exchange Online transport and mail flow, Purview policies, Entra ID groups and Conditional Access as it applies to collaboration workloads.
* Implement to the reference architecture and standards set by the Principal Architect; raise a design challenge when reality does not match the design rather than quietly deviating.
* Deliver backlog items from sprint to production with the tests, telemetry, documentation and rollback path included — "done" means running and observable, not merely configured.
* Build and maintain integrations using Microsoft Graph and platform APIs; write the connective tissue between M365, ServiceNow, HR systems and the wider application estate.
* Automate everything that would otherwise be done twice. Provisioning, lifecycle, reporting, remediation, joiner/mover/leaver flows, licence assignment and reclamation.
* Express tenant configuration as code in version control; build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for policy and solution deployment with automated validation and staged ring-based rollout.
* Replace manual runbook steps with self-healing and self-service; treat a recurring manual task as a defect with a backlog item attached.
* Own operational health of assigned workloads: monitoring, alerting, capacity, service health response and performance.
* Investigate and resolve complex incidents and problems — third-line escalation for collaboration platform issues — and drive permanent root-cause elimination.
* Participate in an on-call rotation for major incidents affecting the collaboration platform.
* Manage the continuous change stream from Microsoft: assess message centre and roadmap items, test in a lab tenant, and implement, defer or disable with the reasoning recorded.
* Maintain patch, currency and configuration compliance; remediate vulnerabilities and drift.
* Implement and maintain security and information governance controls in the collaboration estate: sensitivity labels, DLP, retention, external sharing controls, app consent and Conditional Access.
* Produce the evidence that audits require — configuration baselines, change records, access reviews — generated automatically wherever possible.
* Build to regulated-environment requirements where applicable, including GxP-validated systems and the qualification and change control they demand.
* Work daily with the Product Owner on refinement and estimation, and with the Architect on design; give honest estimates and flag risk early.
* Produce operational documentation, runbooks and knowledge articles good enough that the service desk can use them and the next engineer can pick the work up.
* Support and coach the service desk and second-line teams; reduce escalation volume by transferring capability, not by absorbing it.
* Mentor junior engineers and contribute to engineering standards and code review within the squad.

**Education & Professional Qualifications**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent demonstrable professional experience. Strong practical experience is an acceptable substitute for formal qualification.
* Relevant certifications desirable (e.g., Microsoft 365 Certified: Administrator Expert, Teams Administrator Associate, Identity and Access Administrator Associate, Information Protection and Compliance Administrator, Power Platform Solution Architect, Azure Administrator, ITIL v4 Foundation).

**Area of Specialisation**

* Hands-on Microsoft 365 platform engineering across the core collaboration workloads — Exchange Online, SharePoint Online / OneDrive and Microsoft Teams — at 50,000-user scale.
* Configuration-as-code for tenant settings — Git, CI/CD pipelines, automated validation and staged ring-based rollout — plus advanced PowerShell and Microsoft Graph automation.
* Microsoft Purview implementation — sensitivity labels, DLP, retention — and the practical behaviour of external sharing, Conditional Access and app consent controls once real users meet them.
* Complex collaboration-platform troubleshooting across client, identity, network and service layers, with root-cause elimination rather than ticket closure.

**Experience Required**

* 15Years overall and 10+ years in IT engineering or platform operations, including 5+ years working hands-on with Microsoft 365 in a production enterprise environment.
* Experience supporting or engineering a tenant of 5,000+ users; comfortable with the difference between a small tenant and a large one.
* Demonstrable hands-on capability across at least two of Exchange Online, SharePoint Online/OneDrive, or Microsoft Teams — at a level that includes troubleshooting, not only configuration.
* Working PowerShell proficiency with real examples of automation delivered into production, plus practical experience calling the Microsoft Graph API.
* Familiarity with Git and pull-request-based working; willingness to work configuration-as-code if not already doing so.
* Experience operating in an ITIL-aligned change and incident process, including production change ownership.
* Experience delivering within a Scrum or Kanban squad, including refinement, estimation and sprint commitment.
* Willingness to participate in an on-call rotation for major incidents.
* Fluent English, written and spoken; able to explain a technical issue to a non-technical colleague.

**Desirable:**

* Experience in a regulated industry — pharmaceutical, life sciences, biotech, financial services or healthcare — including GxP/CSV/CSA and validated-system change control.
* Migration delivery at scale — on-premises Exchange or SharePoint to cloud, file share to OneDrive/SharePoint, tenant-to-tenant, or third-party platform (Slack, Zoom, Google Workspace, Box) consolidation.
* Teams Phone / voice — Direct Routing, Operator Connect, PSTN migration.
* Teams Rooms and collaboration hardware — deployment, configuration and remote management at estate scale.
* Viva suite implementation — Connections, Engage, Learning, Insights.
* Power Platform development — Power Automate flows, Power Apps, Dataverse, Copilot Studio agents.
* A second language beyond PowerShell — Python, C# or Go — and experience building small services or Azure Functions.
* Infrastructure-as-code tooling — Bicep, ARM or Terraform for the Azure resources supporting the platform.
* Endpoint management adjacency — Intune, device compliance and the endpoint's role in Conditional Access.
* Security engineering exposure — Defender for Office 365, Defender for Cloud Apps, threat hunting in M365 audit data.
* Accessibility testing and remediation in collaboration tooling.

**Skills/Background**

  

* Deep hands-on configuration and troubleshooting across the core M365 workloads — Exchange Online (mail flow, transport rules, hybrid, anti-spam), SharePoint Online and OneDrive (site and permission models, sharing controls, migration), and Microsoft Teams (policies, lifecycle, meetings, channels).
* Entra ID as it applies to collaboration — groups and dynamic membership, Conditional Access, app registrations and consent, service principals and app-only authentication.
* Microsoft Purview implementation — sensitivity labels, DLP policies, retention and disposition — and the practical behaviour of each once real users meet it.
* Microsoft 365 apps deployment and configuration — servicing channels, policy management via the Cloud Policy service, add-in management.
* Power Platform administration — environments, DLP connector policies, solution deployment and ALM.
* Microsoft 365 Copilot implementation mechanics — licence assignment, permission and oversharing remediation, and grounding behaviour.
* Advanced PowerShell — modules, error handling, parameterisation, idempotency; scripts written to be maintained by someone else, not just to run once.
* Microsoft Graph API fluency — REST, delta queries, permission scopes, app-only auth, throttling and retry handling.
* Monitoring and diagnostics — Log Analytics and KQL, M365 usage and audit telemetry, Power BI reporting; instrumenting your own work so problems surface before users report them.
* Complex troubleshooting — methodical isolation of intermittent, multi-layer problems spanning client, identity, network and service.
* ITIL-aligned practice — incident, problem and change management executed properly at enterprise scale, including credible change records and rollback plans.
* Production discipline — testing in a lab tenant first, ring-based release, blast-radius awareness, and the habit of asking "what does this do to 50,000 people" before pressing apply.
* Clear technical writing — runbooks, knowledge articles and design notes others can actually follow.
* Ownership — sees an item through to working in production and stays with it when it misbehaves afterwards.
* Curiosity and self-direction — reads release notes, tests in a lab, and brings improvement ideas to refinement unprompted.
* Collaboration — works well with product, architecture, security and the service desk; explains technical constraint without condescension.
* User empathy — remembers that a policy setting is somebody's Monday morning.

**Skills**

Access Control (AC), Agile Methodology, Cisco Routing, Cross-Functional Teamwork, Data Analysis, Design Thinking, DevOps, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Data Migration Testing, Microsoft Office 365, Operator Interfaces, Prioritization, Product Development Research, Product Roadmapping, Project Management, Return on Investment (ROI), Software Development, Strategy Deployment, User Experience (UX), User Interface (UI) Design

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.

**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**

If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

  
  
  

Docusign brings agreements to life. More than 1.8 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using the Docusign AI-native IAM platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).

  
  

**What you'll do**
------------------

  
  
  

As the Manager of the Extensibility Platform team at Docusign, you will lead a high-performing, cross-functional engineering team focused on developing and scaling the Extensibility Platform, as well as building new Extension Types and first-party applications. The platform enables internal and external developers to create applications that integrate seamlessly with Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management (IAM) systems. Developers can publish their applications through the Developer Console, making them available in the Docusign App Center for customers to discover and install. You will bring hands-on technical leadership through coding, code reviews, and driving the design and evolution of engineering architectures. You will help ensure the platform remains scalable, configurable, and capable of supporting diverse business scenarios, while strengthening collaboration and communication across engineering, product, and other partner teams.

This position is a people manager role reporting to the Senior Director, Software Engineering.

**Responsibility**

* Conduct thorough code reviews to maintain code quality, reliability, security, and engineering standards
* Create, review, and drive engineering architectures that enable a scalable, configurable Extensibility Platform
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineers on design decisions, implementation approaches, and best practices
* Partner with engineering, product, design, and other teams to align technical solutions with platform and customer needs
* Define and communicate a clear technical vision and strategic roadmap for the Extensibility Platform, emphasizing usability, performance, and scalability
* Work closely with product managers, architects, and other stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver features critical to business success
* Guide the team in producing high-quality, maintainable code, with a strong focus on best practices in testing, monitoring, and logging
* Promote best practices in DevOps, continuous deployment, and Agile methodologies to enhance development efficiency and product quality
* Mentor and develop engineering talent, fostering a culture of innovation, continuous learning, and collaboration
* Engage with external developers and partners to expand the ecosystem of integrations available through the Docusign App Center

  

**Job Designation**
-------------------

  
  
  

**Hybrid:** Employee divides their time between in-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in-office expectation)

Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.

  
  

**What you bring**
------------------

  
  
  

**Basic**

* 5+ years of software development and management experience across multiple languages/frameworks (or equivalent)
* 5+ years of hands-on coding or equivalent
* 5+ years of leading software teams of 5+ people or equivalent
* Proven track record in building solutions that consume and expose APIs/web services
* Experience in SaaS or Cloud environments

**Preferred**

* Expertise with high-availability (99.99%+) distributed systems
* Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and Agile methodologies
* Curiosity and adaptability in learning new tech stacks
* Experience building and scaling platform components for app marketplaces or similar ecosystems
* Prior involvement in designing secure, reliable integrations with third-party apps or services
* Experience in integrating with 3rd party enterprise systems
* Experience in building enterprise software and platforms

  

**Life at Docusign**
--------------------

  
  
  

**Working here**

Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.

We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live.

**Accommodation**

Docusign is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need such an accommodation, or a religious accommodation, during the application process, please contact us at accommodations@docusign.com.

If you experience any issues, concerns, or technical difficulties during the application process please get in touch with our Talent organization at taops@docusign.com for assistance.
