title: Principal Firmware Engineer (Security)
description:
**Company Description**

**About Axiado**

Axiado is redefining how AI infrastructure gets secured and managed. Founded in 2019, we’re a fast-growing, well-funded team of over 180 people worldwide, building the Trusted Control/Compute Unit (TCU), a new class of semiconductor that integrates hardware security, real-time platform management, and AI-driven optimization. Our TCU-based Platform Efficiency Controller is shipping hardware that makes AI servers measurably more efficient, more secure, and more reliable, and we’re extending that foundation into a hardware-anchored management fabric that scales from a single board to the whole fleet.

Backed by strong funding and validated by commercial programs with Tier 1 industry leaders, Axiado has earned recognition through numerous industry awards, including the 2026 AI in Cybersecurity Innovation Award from TMCnet, a Diamond award for Zero Trust Solution of the Year at the 2026 Pinnacle Awards, and Gold at the 2026 Cybersecurity Excellence Awards for AI Security Solution, as well as being a finalist for the Start-Up to Watch Award from the Global Semiconductor Alliance. We’re small enough that every person’s work visibly shapes the company, and we look for people who want to build, not just execute. Every employee holds equity, meaning your work directly builds your stake in the company’s future, not just a paycheck. If you want to help define what comes next, let’s talk.

 **Job Description**

We are seeking an experienced Principal Firmware Engineer to manage a talented team while remaining a highly hands-on technical contributor. You will lead the design, development, and optimization of highly secure embedded systems. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in Secure Boot, attestation schemes such as SPDM, secure provisioning, cryptographic firmware signing, and key/certificate revocation mechanisms, alongside strong knowledge of RTOS, Linux kernels, device drivers, and bus protocols. This "player-coach" role requires exceptional problem-solving skills to diagnose and resolve complex hardware-security interactions, as well as the leadership abilities to guide, mentor, and manage a high-performing engineering team.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Team Management & Hands-On Contribution: Lead, manage, and grow a team of firmware engineers while remaining a core individual contributor. Dedicate a significant portion of your time to writing code, conducting code reviews, and resolving low-level technical challenges.
* Security Architecture & Boot Flow: Architect, develop, and optimize embedded software solutions with a primary focus on end-to-end platform security, including Secure Boot, hardware Root of Trust (RoT), and verified boot pipelines.
* Protocols & Provisioning: Implement and manage attestation schemes such as SPDM for device authentication and remote measurement, alongside secure factory and field secure provisioning workflows.
* Firmware Signing & Lifecycle Management: Design and maintain cryptographic firmware signing infrastructure, secure update pipelines, and robust revocation mechanisms (such as anti-rollback counters, key revocation lists, and certificate revocation).
* Debugging & Security Analysis: Diagnose and resolve complex hardware/software and cryptographic failure modes using advanced debugging tools (JTAG, GDB, logic analyzers).
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with security experts, hardware engineers, and system architects to define roadmaps and deliver scalable embedded security solutions, while contributing to open-source security standards or embedded projects.

 **Qualifications**

**Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
* Experience: 20+ years of experience in embedded software development, featuring a strong foundational background in C/C++.

* Team Leadership: Proven track record of managing and leading engineering teams while maintaining an active, hands-on role in software development and system architecture.
* Security Expertise:
  + Proven experience with Secure Boot, Root of Trust (RoT), and cryptographic security principles (symmetric/asymmetric cryptography, hashing, digital signatures).
  + Hands-on implementation experience with attestation schemes such as SPDM for hardware authentication and platform measurement.
  + In-depth knowledge of secure provisioning methodologies, HSM (Hardware Security Module) integration, and secure key storage.
  + Robust understanding of firmware signing workflows and lifecycle revocation architectures (e.g., CRLs, embedded validation, fuse-based key revocation).
* System Software & Hardware: Extensive experience with RTOS, Linux kernel, device drivers, and hardware bring-up using Board Support Packages (BSPs).
* Protocols & Interfaces: Strong grasp of peripheral interfaces (SPI, I2C, UART, USB) and bus protocols (PCIe, Ethernet), with PCIe root port and SR-IOV knowledge being a strong plus.
* Toolchains & Build Systems: Familiarity with Linux build frameworks such as Yocto and Buildroot, alongside low-level debugging via JTAG and GDB.
* Preferred Domains: Experience with Baseboard Management Controllers (BMC) and hardware security accelerators.

 **Additional Information**

Axiado is committed to attracting, developing, and retaining the highest caliber talent in a diverse and multifaceted environment. We are headquartered in the heart of Silicon Valley, with access to the world's leading research, technology and talent.

We are building an exceptional team to secure every node on the internet. For us, solving real-world problems takes precedence over purely theoretical problems. As a result, we prefer individuals with persistence, intelligence and high curiosity over pedigree alone. Working hard and smart, continuous learning and mutual support are all part of who we are.

Axiado is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Axiado does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

title: Senior Solutions Architect – AI Infrastructure Networking (remote in India)
description:
**Company Description**

**About Mirantis**

Mirantis, an IREN company, is the Kubernetes-native AI infrastructure company, enabling organizations to build and operate scalable, secure, and sovereign infrastructure for modern AI, machine learning, and data-intensive applications. By combining open source innovation with deep expertise in Kubernetes orchestration, Mirantis empowers platform engineering teams to deliver composable, production-ready developer platforms across any environment—on-premises, in the cloud, at the edge, or in sovereign data centers. As enterprises navigate the growing complexity of AI-driven workloads, Mirantis delivers the automation, GPU orchestration, and policy-driven control needed to manage infrastructure with confidence and agility. Committed to open standards and freedom from lock-in, Mirantis ensures that customers retain full control of their infrastructure strategy. https://www.mirantis.com/

 **Job Description**

About the role

We are seeking a Senior Solutions Architect with deep networking expertise to join the Voyager team in the Mirantis Office of the CTO. You will own the network solutioning of k0rdent AI, our platform for building and operating GPU clouds and AI factories, from metal to model.

You will design how large GPU clusters are interconnected, how tenants are isolated, and how workloads reach the network from containers, virtual machines and bare metal nodes. You will turn that design into published reference architectures, working code and proofs of concept that run on real hardware with our customers and partners.

As part of the Office of the CTO, research is a core part of the job. You will explore designs and technologies before customers ask for them, prototype ideas that may not ship, and challenge established practice when a better approach exists. Your work will shape where k0rdent AI goes next, not only how it is deployed today.

This role combines research with hands-on, outward-facing work. You will split your time between exploring new designs, writing architecture, building and validating it in the lab, and explaining it to engineers, executives and conference audiences. You will work with Solutions Architects, Partner Management and Engineering colleagues across many countries and time zones.

Key Responsibilities

Reference architecture

* Design and publish network reference architectures and solution designs for k0rdent AI, covering data center topologies from a single rack to multi-thousand-GPU clusters.
* Define compute (east-west) fabrics on InfiniBand and on RoCEv2 Ethernet, including rail-optimised and fat-tree / Clos designs, oversubscription and failure-domain choices.
* Define front-end, storage and management networks, and how they connect to customer data centers, public clouds and hybrid environments.
* Specify multi-tenant isolation across the stack: InfiniBand partitions (PKeys), VRFs and EVPN-VXLAN on Ethernet, and Kubernetes-level network policy.
* Document scale limits and trade-offs (cost, performance, operability, vendor lock-in) with defensible reasoning a customer can follow.

Host and platform networking

* Define how Linux hosts expose NICs, DPUs and SuperNICs to workloads: PCI passthrough, SR-IOV virtual functions, IOMMU groups, NUMA and GPU-NIC affinity.
* Design Kubernetes networking for AI workloads: primary and secondary CNIs, Multus, SR-IOV and RDMA device plugins, NVIDIA Network Operator, and Dynamic Resource Allocation (DRA).
* Design networking for virtual machines on KubeVirt, including passthrough and SR-IOV for GPU and RDMA traffic.

Research and exploration

* Track and evaluate emerging technologies and standards in AI networking, such as Ultra Ethernet (UEC), SuperNIC and DPU offloads, scale-up and scale-across fabrics, and Kubernetes DRA network drivers.
* Prototype alternative designs in the lab, including ones customers have not yet asked for, and measure them against current practice.
* Challenge established or customer-preferred designs when evidence points to a better option, and make the case with data.
* Publish findings as internal research notes and design proposals and, where appropriate, as external papers, blog posts or talks.

Code and proofs of concept

* Build and run proofs of concept with customers and partners, on Mirantis lab hardware and on customer sites, and report results against agreed success criteria.
* Write automation and tooling (Python, Go, Bash, Ansible, Helm, Kubernetes manifests, Terraform) that makes the reference architectures reproducible.
* Run validation and benchmarking of fabrics and host configurations (e.g. NCCL tests, perftest, ib\_write\_bw) and turn findings into design guidance.

Customers, partners and community

* Act as the network subject matter expert in customer discovery, design reviews and architecture workshops, bringing thought leadership and new ideas rather than only reflecting current practice.
* Work with hardware and networking partners (e.g. NVIDIA, server OEMs, switch and network vendors) on joint designs and validations.
* Innovate and feed research results back to Product and Engineering, and help shape the k0rdent AI roadmap.
* Present at industry events, webinars and partner summits, and run hands-on workshops for technical audiences.
* Write technical content: reference architecture documents, solution briefs, blog posts and internal enablement.

 **Qualifications**

Education and experience

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8+ years in network engineering or network architecture, with at least 3 years in data center, HPC or cloud infrastructure networking.
* Customer-facing experience as a solutions architect, pre-sales engineer, consultant or technical lead.

Required technical skills

* Data center network design: spine-leaf and Clos topologies, rail-optimised GPU fabrics, oversubscription, ECMP, and the operational challenges of scaling to thousands of nodes.
* InfiniBand: subnet management, partitioning, adaptive routing, and how NCCL / RDMA traffic behaves on the fabric.
* RoCEv2 on Ethernet: lossless and congestion-controlled designs (PFC, ECN, DCQCN), QoS, MTU and buffer tuning.
* Routing and overlays: BGP, EVPN-VXLAN, VRFs and their use for multi-tenancy.
* Hybrid and multi-cloud connectivity: interconnects, VPN, cloud provider networking constructs, and IP address and DNS planning across sites.
* Linux networking: how the kernel and drivers manage NICs, PCI passthrough, SR-IOV, IOMMU, NUMA affinity, and tools such as iproute2, ethtool and devlink.
* Kubernetes networking: CNI plugins (e.g. Cilium, Calico, OVN-Kubernetes), Multus and secondary networks, SR-IOV and RDMA device plugins, network policy and service exposure.
* Virtualisation on Kubernetes: KubeVirt, and how VM networking, passthrough and SR-IOV are configured there.
* Programming or scripting in at least one language (Python or Go preferred), and comfortable using Git, CI and infrastructure-as-code.

How you work

We hire for these behaviours as much as for technical depth, and will ask for concrete examples of each.

* Curious. You dig into why a fabric behaves the way it does, read the specs and the source, and keep up with how AI networking is changing. You question established designs, including the ones customers are used to, when there is a better way.
* Ownership. You take a reference architecture or a POC from the first sketch to a published, validated result, and you stand behind it.
* Proactive. You spot gaps in the product, the documentation or a customer design before you are asked, and you act on them.
* Fast learner. You get productive quickly in unfamiliar hardware, software or customer environments.
* Business acumen. You connect network design choices to cost, time-to-value and risk, and explain them in those terms to decision makers.

Communication and collaboration

* Excellent written and spoken English; you write documents others can build from.
* Comfortable presenting to large audiences at conferences and events, and running hands-on workshops.
* Able to adapt the message to the audience, from network engineers to customer executives.
* Experience working in an international, distributed company, across time zones and different work cultures, with Solutions Architects, Partner Management and Engineering teams.

Nice to have

* Hands-on experience with NVIDIA networking: Quantum InfiniBand, Spectrum-X Ethernet, ConnectX SuperNICs, BlueField DPUs, UFM, and NVIDIA reference designs for AI factories.
* Experience with GPU cloud, neocloud or HPC operators, or with NVIDIA Cloud Partner (NCP) style deployments.
* Bare-metal provisioning and lifecycle: Metal3, Ironic, Redfish, PXE / iPXE, and Cluster API.
* Network automation and SDN controllers, and switch operating systems such as Cumulus Linux, SONiC or vendor equivalents.
* Global load balancing and service exposure for distributed inference (GSLB, Gateway API, ingress).
* Familiarity with Software-Defined Storage networking for AI (NVMe-oF, GPUDirect Storage).
* Experience with Mirantis products, MKE, k0s, k0rdent networking.
* Contributions to open-source networking or Kubernetes projects, or a track record of public talks and technical writing.
* Participation in standards or industry bodies (e.g. Ultra Ethernet Consortium, OCP, IETF), or published research, patents or white papers.
* Additional languages beyond English, for example a European language.

Location, travel and working model

This role is remote, open to candidates based in Europe.

* You will work with a team spread across many time zones; some meetings will fall outside standard local hours.
* Travel of up to 25% for customer engagements, partner meetings, lab work and industry events, primarily within the EU and US.
* Mirantis is an equal opportunity employer. Compensation and benefits are set according to the local market and employment arrangement.

 **Additional Information**

**Why you’ll love Mirantis**

* Build the observability foundation for the AI cloud era, working directly with leading GPU cloud operators, NeoClouds, sovereign clouds, and AI-first enterprises
* Collaborate with a world-class, distributed team committed to openness and technical excellence
* Shape the product narrative and influence go-to-market success

**It is understood that Mirantis, Inc. may use automated decision-making technology (ADMT) for specific employment-related decisions. Opting out of ADMT use is requested for decisions about evaluation and review connected with the specific employment decision for the position applied for. You also have the right to appeal any decisions made by ADMT by sending your request to isamoylova@mirantis.com**

By submitting your resume, you consent to the processing and storage of your personal data in accordance with applicable data protection laws, for the purposes of considering your application for current and future job opportunities.

title: Staff Software Development Engineer - OpenBMC / Platform Management
description:
Overview:

**ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.**

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.

Responsibilities:

**Staff Software Development Engineer - OpenBMC / Platform Management**

**THE ROLE:**

AMD is seeking a highly motivated Software Development Engineer to join our Embedded System Software team, building the OpenBMC and platform management software that runs on AMD Adaptive SoC platforms. You will contribute to the OpenBMC distribution for AMD platforms, delivering management, telemetry, and serviceability for servers, AI accelerators, and next-generation data center and embedded systems.

Working alongside AMD silicon architects, hardware designers, firmware teams, and the OpenBMC open-source community, you will take new platforms from first power-on through to a supportable, upstreamable solution, and build the reference designs that AMD product teams and external customers adopt for their own platforms.

**THE PERSON:**

The ideal candidate is passionate about platform management software and enjoys solving complex system-level challenges that span hardware and software boundaries. You possess strong software engineering fundamentals, deep expertise in OpenBMC and embedded Linux, and a proven ability to drive features from concept through platform bring-up and into production.

You are comfortable working across the full stack, from an I2C device to a Redfish endpoint, and have the communication skills to collaborate effectively with architects and engineering teams across AMD.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* **OpenBMC Software Stack:** Contribute to the OpenBMC distribution for AMD platforms, including the phosphor services, D-Bus interfaces, and application layer that deliver manageability on AMD platforms.
* **Hardware Description and Telemetry:** Develop Entity Manager configurations, sensor and FRU definitions, and the thermal, power, and fan control behaviour for each platform.
* **Management Interfaces:** Deliver the out-of-band management surface, including Redfish and bmcweb, IPMI, remote console and KVM, and MCTP and PLDM transports.
* **Firmware Update and Security:** Build the update and recovery path, including image signing, A/B and golden-image recovery, root-of-trust integration, secure boot, and attestation.
* **Platform and Board Bring-Up:** Participate in new platform and board bring-up from first power-on, driving issues to root cause with hardware, firmware, and silicon architecture teams.
* **Yocto Integration:** Maintain the Yocto layers and recipes that build and configure the BMC software stack across platforms and releases.
* **Upstream and Technical Leadership:** Contribute to the OpenBMC project, keep AMD trees in step with upstream, mentor junior engineers, and contribute to architecture reviews.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Experience with **OpenBMC** or a comparable BMC software stack, including components such as Entity Manager, D-Bus services, bmcweb and Redfish, and IPMI.
* Working knowledge of **BMC products and the platform management domain** — server, storage, or AI accelerator board bring-up, out-of-band management, remote console and KVM, and interfaces such as I2C, eSPI, PECI, APML, MCTP, and PLDM.
* Strong **embedded Linux** background, including the Linux kernel from a platform integration standpoint: device trees, kernel configuration, driver enablement, and sysfs and hwmon.
* Working experience with the **Yocto Project and OpenEmbedded** — layers, recipes, and bbappends.
* Strong programming skills in **C and C++**, and proficiency in Python or shell scripting.
* Experience debugging complex system-level issues spanning operating systems, drivers, firmware, and hardware, and familiarity with **Git and CI/CD** workflows.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Platform security and root of trust: secure and measured boot, firmware signing, and attestation.
* Experience developing **reference designs, demonstration platforms, or proof-of-concept solutions** adopted by product teams or external customers.
* **DC-SCM, DC-MHS, OCP**, or other modular hardware and open compute standards.
* Experience with **AMD Adaptive SoCs and FPGA technologies**, including AMD Vivado™ or Vitis™.
* **Zephyr or another embedded RTOS**, **RISC-V**, and inter-processor communication frameworks such as **OpenAMP**.
* Contributions to OpenBMC, Yocto Project, or Linux open-source projects.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, and demonstrated technical leadership.

**ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:**

Bachelor's degree + 8 years of experience or Master's degree + 6 years of experience in Computer

Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

The GeoSpatial Lead Analyst MAP will design implement and optimize geospatial applications and services using Java Spring Boot or Dot Net and Selenium based automation in a hybrid work model. The role focuses on building robust spatial data solutions ensuring high reliability through automated testing and collaborating with cross functional teams to deliver high quality map based products that support strategic business decisions and societal impact through improved location intelligence.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead end to end design and implementation of geospatial applications that power map based services and spatial analytics ensuring robust performance scalability and maintainability in alignment with enterprise standards.
* Drive the development of backend services using Java Spring Boot or Dot Net to process and expose spatial data through secure and efficient application programming interfaces that support large scale consumption.
* Coordinate with product data and infrastructure teams to translate business requirements into clear geospatial solution designs that improve service reliability and enhance decision making for stakeholders.
* Architect and refine spatial data models and indexing strategies that optimize query performance and accuracy for routing proximity search and advanced spatial analyses.
* Implement comprehensive automation test suites using Selenium and Java to validate geospatial user interfaces workflows and integration points across environments and releases.
* Establish rigorous quality gates by defining test strategies coverage metrics and defect management practices that improve release confidence and reduce production incidents.
* Collaborate closely with mapping and data engineering teams to ingest transform and validate large volumes of geospatial data ensuring consistency completeness and alignment with industry standards.
* Guide peers on best practices for geospatial application development including coding patterns error handling performance tuning and observability tailored to spatial workloads.
* Analyze production trends incident data and user feedback to identify opportunities for optimization in geospatial services and implement targeted improvements that enhance user experience.
* Create and maintain detailed technical documentation for geospatial services automation frameworks and integration patterns to support maintainability reuse and onboarding of new team members.
* Engage with cross functional partners to ensure geospatial solutions align with organizational priorities and contribute to societal impact through improved transportation planning resource allocation and emergency response support.
* Support compliance with security privacy and governance standards by embedding secure coding practices and data protection principles into geospatial application and test design.
* Contribute to continuous improvement by evaluating emerging geospatial technologies and automation tools and recommending adoption strategies that strengthen the mapping platform capability.

**Qualifications**

* Possess nine to thirteen years of hands on experience in enterprise application development with strong proficiency in Java and Spring Boot or Dot Net frameworks applied to complex data driven solutions.
* Demonstrate solid experience designing and implementing geospatial or map centric applications where spatial data spatial queries or location intelligence form a core part of the product functionality.
* Show proven capability in building and maintaining automation test frameworks using Selenium and Java including functional regression and integration testing for complex web applications.
* Apply strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals including design patterns clean code principles version control and continuous integration practices in daily work.
* Utilize working knowledge of hybrid work models and modern collaboration tools to coordinate effectively with distributed teams and maintain productivity across onsite and remote settings.
* Exhibit familiarity with spatial data concepts such as projections coordinate systems tiling and spatial indexing along with experience using relevant data stores or geospatial libraries.
* Display strong analytical and problem solving skills that enable thorough investigation of geospatial defects performance bottlenecks and data quality issues leading to sustainable fixes.
* Preferably bring exposure to cloud platforms and container based deployments for hosting geospatial services and automation test pipelines in scalable and resilient environments.

title: Sr. Staff Cyber Security Architect
description:
**Job Description Summary**
===========================

This position will work on highly complex projects that require in-depth domain knowledge in two or more specialized areas. They are responsible for driving the design and implementation efforts related to architecture, scalability, availability and performance alignment w/ the product roadmap with a focus on application development & automation. They may interact w/ functional leaders to support these technical initiatives.

**Job Description**
===================

**Roles and Responsibilities**

In this role, you will:

* Drive significant endpoint security technology initiatives across multiple layers of architecture, including Linux, Kubernetes, Application, and Cloud platforms.
* Partner with product management, product owners and architects to identify & prioritize security features across the system.
* Work to design implement projects to transform products within the portfolio through automation orchestration opportunities.
* A focus on automation & orchestration and furthering the integration of Cyber Security & Risk management into the native development workflow.
* Contribute to the development of infrastructure platforms that are service-oriented with reusable components that can be orchestrated together into different methods for different businesses
* Participate in the research and evaluation of emerging technology, industry and market trends to assist in project development and/or operational support actives.

**Technical Qualification**

* Deep experience in **Linux and Kubernetes security**, including OS hardening, container security, RBAC, workload isolation, secure boot and runtime protection.
* Strong expertise in **Identity, PKI and Zero Trust**, including OAuth2/OIDC, certificates, TLS/mTLS, key management, workload identity and technologies such as **Keycloak/OpenPKI/Vault**.
* Strong knowledge of **software supply-chain security**, including SBOM, CVE/VEX management, SAST/SCA, container scanning, artifact signing, software provenance and tools such as **Trivy, Black Duck, Cosign/Sigstore and GitLab security tooling**.
* Experience designing **DevSecOps and Security-as-Code**, integrating automated security controls into CI/CD using tools such as GitLab CI, OPA/Rego, Kyverno, Helm and infrastructure-as-code.
* Strong **security architecture and threat-modeling** capability using techniques such as STRIDE, attack-surface analysis, trust-boundary analysis and secure-design patterns.
* Experience with **network, API and communication security**, including network segmentation, API gateways, secure remote connectivity, TLS/mTLS and Zero Trust networking.
* Experience with **runtime security, audit logging and security monitoring**, preferably across Kubernetes and distributed edge systems.
* Ability to architect security across **edge, customer datacenter and cloud deployments**.
* Strong understanding of **medical-device cybersecurity and secure product development**, including FDA cybersecurity expectations, IEC 81001-5-1, IEC 62304, NIST SSDF and related risk-management practices.

**Education Qualification**

  

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or “STEM” Majors (Science, Technology, Engineering and Math) with significant experience in Cybersecurity domain with a minimum of 14 years of experience.

**Desired Characteristics**

* Strong decision-making capabilities, with a proven ability to weigh the relative costs and benefits of potential actions and identify the most appropriate one.
* Strong interpersonal skills, with an emphasis on the ability to effectively influence others
* A team-focused mentality with the proven ability to work effectively with diverse stakeholders.
* An ability to communicate complex and technical issues to diverse audiences, orally and in writing, in an easily-understood, authoritative, and actionable manner.
* **Hands-on architecture mindset**, capable of building reusable security capabilities into the Compute Platform rather than relying only on governance, reviews and compliance processes.

Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. title: Sr Engineer - Physical Design & Signoff (Synthesis to GDS2)
description:
**Date posted** 10/13/2026

### **Category** **Engineering****Hire Type** **Employee****Job ID** **17521****Remote Eligible** **No****Date Posted** **10/13/2026**

### **We Are**

At Synopsys, we drive the innovations that shape the way we live and connect. Our technology is central to the Era of Pervasive Intelligence, from self-driving cars to learning machines. We lead in chip design, verification, and IP integration, empowering the creation of high-performance silicon chips and software content. Join us to transform the future through continuous technological innovation.

  
  

### **You Are**

You are an experienced, self-motivated engineering professional with a deep-rooted passion for semiconductor technology and innovation. Your technical expertise spans Physical Design, Physical Verification, and Static Timing Analysis (STA) at the IP/block/full chip level, and you are adept at navigating the complexities of advanced Finfet and GAA process technologies. You thrive in fast-paced, collaborative environments, drawing energy from teamwork and cross-functional problem-solving. You have a strong analytical mindset, coupled with a keen eye for detail, enabling you to deliver robust, high-quality solutions that meet stringent performance and reliability requirements. Your communication skills empower you to clearly articulate technical concepts and collaborate effectively with both local and global teams, as well as external customers. You are proactive, always seeking new ways to improve methodologies and processes, and you are committed to continuous learning and professional growth. Your dedication to excellence and innovation drives you to contribute meaningfully to the development of industry-leading products. If you are eager to work at the cutting edge of chip design and play a pivotal role in shaping the next generation of silicon technologies, Synopsys is the place for you.

  
  

### **What You’ll Be Doing**

* Conceptualizing, designing, and productizing state-of-the-art RTL to GDS implementation for SLM monitors using ASIC design flows.
* Designing on-chip Process, Voltage, Temperature, glitch, and Droop monitors for silicon biometrics and reliability.
* Executing digital backend activities, including synthesis, pre-layout STA, SDC constraints development, floor planning, bump placement, power planning, MV design techniques, VCLP, UPF understanding, placement, CTS, and routing.
* Driving post-layout STA, timing and functional ECO development, and timing signoff methodology for high-frequency IP design closure.
* Performing physical verification tasks such as DRC, LVS, PERC, ERC, Antenna, EMIR, and Power signoff.
* Collaborating with architects and circuit design engineering teams to create and refine new flows and methodologies.
* Ensuring pre-layout and post-layout timing closure and timing model characterizations across various design corners, meeting reliability and aging requirements for automotive and consumer products.
  

  

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* Accelerating the integration of next-generation intelligent in-chip sensors and analytics into Synopsys technology products.
* Optimizing performance, power, area, schedule, and yield at every stage of the semiconductor lifecycle.
* Enhancing product reliability and differentiation in the market, reducing risk for customers and partners.
* Driving innovation in physical design, verification, STA, and signoff methodologies and tools.
* Contributing to industry-leading SLM monitors and silicon biometrics solutions that set new standards.
* Collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure successful deployment and adoption of advanced technologies.
  

  

### **What You’ll Need**

* BS/B.Tech or MS/M.Tech in Electrical Engineering with 3+ years of relevant industry experience.
* Strong knowledge and hands-on experience in Physical Design, Physical Verification, pre- & post-layout STA, and EMIR/Power signoff, including SDC development and UPF/Multivoltage design.
* Mandatory experience with DRC, LVS, DFM cleaning, and timing closure.
* Proficiency in digital design tools from any EDA vendor, preferably Synopsys tools (FC/VCLP/PT/PT-PX/ICV/Redhawk).
* Sound understanding of Physical Design, Physical Verification, STA, and signoff concepts, with proven track record in generating ECO for DRV cleaning and timing closure.
* Experience with advanced nodes (14nm, 10nm, 7nm, 5nm, 3nm, 2nm) and successful tape-outs.
* Good understanding of OCV, POCV, derates, crosstalk, and design margins.
* Experience in scripting (TCL/PERL) for custom methodologies and flow enhancements.
  

  

### **Who You Are**

* Proactive and detail-oriented with excellent problem-solving skills.
* Adept at working independently and providing innovative physical design and signoff solutions.
* Excellent communicator and team player, capable of collaborating effectively with diverse teams.
* Innovative thinker with a passion for technology and continuous improvement.
* Committed to delivering high-quality results and achieving ambitious project goals.
  

  

### **The Team You’ll Be A Part Of**

You’ll join a dynamic, collaborative team of engineering professionals focused on advancing the state-of-the-art in chip design and verification. The team works closely with architects, circuit designers, and cross-functional partners to deliver innovative solutions for semiconductor lifecycle monitoring, reliability, and performance. With a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing, you’ll be empowered to contribute ideas and play a key role in shaping the future of Synopsys technology.

At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

**Job Title:** Principal Python Software Architect / Staff Engineer

**Experience Level:** 12 – 18 Years

**Location:** [City, Country / Hybrid / Remote]

Job Purpose

We are seeking a visionary **Principal / Lead Python Software Architect** with 12 to 18 years of hands-on technical and leadership experience to lead the architectural evolution, performance optimization, and technical strategy of our enterprise platform.

In this role, you will design resilient, scalable distributed systems, modernize legacy backend pipelines, establish enterprise-wide Python engineering standards, and integrate cutting-edge asynchronous processing, data processing, or AI/ML workloads into our core infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities1. Enterprise Architecture & System Design

* **Distributed Systems Design:** Architect, scale, and maintain fault-tolerant, low-latency, and high-concurrency microservices architectures using modern **Python (3.11/3.12+)**.
* **Framework & Ecosystem Mastery:** Architect complex web services, REST/gRPC APIs, and asynchronous message-driven systems using **FastAPI, Django, Flask, Asyncio, Celery, and RabbitMQ/Kafka**.
* **Modernization & Refactoring:** Drive migration and refactoring strategies from legacy backend monoliths into scalable, cloud-native microservices or event-driven frameworks.
* **AI/Data Pipeline Integration:** Oversee the architectural integration of machine learning models, vector databases, semantically indexed search engines, or LLM workflows into production systems.

2. Engineering Governance, Security & Performance

* **Performance Engineering:** Troubleshoot deep memory leaks, event loop bottlenecks, and execute CPU/IO profiling to achieve ultra-low latency and efficient memory management.
* **Database Architecture:** Design, optimize, and manage high-volume relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB, Cassandra, Redis) databases, including complex query optimization and sharding/partitioning strategies.
* **Security & Compliance:** Enforce enterprise-grade security standards (OWASP, OAuth2/OIDC, data encryption at rest/in transit, zero-trust backend architecture).
* **Code Excellence & CI/CD:** Establish automated testing standards (PyTest), static analysis tools (Mypy, Ruff, Black), and containerized CI/CD deployment automation (Docker, Kubernetes).

3. Leadership, Mentorship & Technical Strategy

* **Technical Roadmap:** Collaborate closely with the CTO, Product Managers, and Executive Leadership to translate long-term business strategy into robust tech roadmaps.
* **Engineering Mentorship:** Lead, mentor, and elevate Technical Leads, Senior Engineers, and cross-functional engineering teams, fostering a strong culture of innovation and engineering rigor.
* **Vendor & Tooling Evaluation:** Evaluate and select third-party cloud tools, frameworks, and infrastructure services to maximize operational efficiency and cost ROI.

Technical Qualifications & Requirements

* **Total Experience:** 12 to 18 years of progressive software engineering experience, with **8+ years dedicated to Python backend development** at massive scale.
* **Core Python Expertise:** Deep internal mastery of Python (Memory Management, GIL internals, Asyncio, Multiprocessing, Metaclasses, Generators, and Type Hinting).
* **Backend Stack:** Proven expertise in **FastAPI / Django / Flask**, SQLAlchemy, Pydantic, gRPC, RESTful APIs, and GraphQL.
* **Concurrency & Message Queues:** Hands-on experience with asynchronous task processing via Kafka, RabbitMQ, Celery, or Redis Pub/Sub.
* **Databases & Caching:** Mastery of PostgreSQL / MySQL query optimization, schema design, and caching layers (Redis, Memcached).
* **Cloud & Infrastructure:** Hands-on experience with cloud environments (**AWS / GCP / Azure**), Docker, Kubernetes, Serverless architectures, and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform / CloudFormation).
* **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical industry experience.

Soft Skills & Leadership Profile

* **Strategic Business Acumen:** Ability to evaluate technical trade-offs with business ROI, cost, and time-to-market top of mind.
* **Executive Communication:** Skilled at presenting complex architectural concepts clearly to both technical engineers and non-technical C-suite executives.
* **Crisis Management:** Decisive leadership during major production outages, complex security incidents, or critical release cycles.

title: Senior Hardware Engineer (Railways & Embedded Systems)
description:
**Company Overview**We are a fast-growing **MSME Engineering company** dedicated to delivering cutting-edge, mission-critical electronic systems for the defense and transport sectors, with a heavy focus on **Indian Railways** applications. As we scale, we are seeking a highly skilled and independent engineer to champion our hardware lifecycle from concept to field deployment.**Role Objective**The **Senior Hardware Engineer** will independently handle the end-to-end design, development, and validation of complex ruggedized electronic systems. You will lead a lean engineering team, ensuring all products comply strictly with **RDSO specifications** and international railway standards.

**Key Product Ownership**You will be the primary custodian for the design and manufacturing support of:

* **Safety & Communication:** Crew Voice and Video Recording (CVVR) systems, UHF Radio Communication, Voice over IP (VoIP), GPS & GSM technologies.
* **Train Networking:** Train Communication Network (TCN VCU), Train Control Management System (TCMS), MVB, and Radio Signals MVB.
* **Monitoring & Automation:** On-Board Condition Monitoring Systems (OBCMS), Remote Monitoring Systems, Coach Under-Slung Water Level Indicators, Cameras, M-NVRs, and rugged PoE Switches.

**Requirements & Technical Qualifications**

**Education & Experience**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s Degree (B.E./B.Tech) in **Electronic Engineering** or higher.
* **Experience:** Minimum **6+ years** of core hardware design and manufacturing experience, with at least **2 years as a Lead Engineer**.

**Core Technical Skills**

* **Microcontrollers & Processors:** In-depth programming and architecture knowledge of 8-bit, 16-bit, 32-bit, and **ARM microcontrollers**, DSPs, and Intel motherboards.
* **Circuit Design:** Expertise in **Analog and Digital circuit design** (DSP, FPGA), System-on-Module (SoM) architecture, and control electronics for embedded systems.
* **High-Speed Design:** Proven experience in High-Speed Board Design, Signal Integrity (SI), FPGA code development/validation, PCIe bus design, simulation, and DC Power circuit design.
* **Communication Interfaces:** Practical design and debugging experience with **CAN, PCIe, USB, Ethernet, RS485, and RS232**.
* **EDA Tools:** Advanced proficiency in Electronic Design Automation (EDA) tools for schematic capture, PCB layout support, hardware bring-up, and bench-top validation.

**Standards, Testing & Compliance**

* **Railway Standards:** Thorough working knowledge of Indian Railways **RDSO specifications** and international train electronic standards, including:
* **IEC 60571 / EN 50155** (Electronic equipment used on rolling stock)
* **IEC 61375** (Train Communication Network / MVB)
* **EMI/EMC:** Solid track record of implementing **EMI/EMC mitigation solutions** and passing validation as per IEC standards.
* **Hardware Architecture:** Direct exposure to test protocols for industrial/railway grade cameras, M-NVRs, and network switches.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Product Lifecycle Management:** Drive product development independently from initial block diagram to final manufacturing-ready files (Gerbers, BOM, Assembly drawings).
* **Compliance Leadership:** Architect systems to natively pass harsh environmental, thermal, and electrical tests dictated by RDSO/IS/IEC protocols.
* **Triage & Troubleshooting:** Act as the technical anchor to debug, root-cause, and resolve complex hardware anomalies working seamlessly with cross-functional software and firmware teams.
* **Mentorship:** Guide junior engineers through schematic reviews, simulation checks, and strict validation methodologies.

Pay: ₹686,000.00 - ₹1,500,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Hardware -Embedded Engineer
description:
Countai Private Limited is seeking a highly skilled Embedded & Controls Engineer to help develop the next generation of deployable quantum networking hardware.

You will take end-to-end ownership of the electronics and control architecture that connects our advanced photonic and quantum hardware to countai software and orchestration platforms. Your work will span custom PCB design, mixed-signal and high-speed electronics, FPGA and embedded systems, firmware, precision control algorithms, hardware APIs, and rack-level system integration.

Working closely with our photonics, software, systems, and mechanical engineering teams, you will transform laboratory prototypes into robust, manufacturable systems capable of operating outside the laboratory. You will address challenging requirements including ultra-low-noise electronics, precise synchronization, sub-nanosecond timing, high-speed signal integrity, closed-loop optical control, and reliable remote management.

Your work will establish the electronic and control infrastructure required to bring Countai private limited from research prototypes into scalable, field-deployable platforms.

**You Will**

* Architect custom mixed-signal PCBs for precision control, data acquisition, timing, and communication within rack-mounted quantum systems.
* Develop embedded software and firmware to control custom electronics, optical components, and photonic devices.
* Design high-speed analog and digital signal paths while maintaining stringent requirements for signal integrity, latency, synchronization, and noise.
* Interface with embedded processors, FPGAs, ADCs, DACs, and discrete control and telemetry signals.
* Design, implement, and tune digital control loops for precision regulation and stabilization of optical and electronic hardware.
* Architect low-noise power distribution, grounding, and control electronics for sensitive quantum hardware.
* Develop interfaces for system communication using technologies such as Ethernet, UART, SPI, USB, GPIO, and high-speed data-converter interfaces.
* Define and implement APIs that enable higher-level software platforms to control hardware and access system status and telemetry.
* Develop custom cable harnessing and interconnect solutions for RF, digital, analog, telemetry, and high-speed signals.
* Collaborate with software, systems, mechanical, optical, and photonics engineers to optimize thermal performance, grounding, EMI/EMC, signal integrity, and overall system reliability.
* Lead hardware bring-up and debug complex interactions between electronics, firmware, FPGA logic, and system-level software.
* Create and implement comprehensive hardware, firmware, and system-level test plans; analyze results and drive design improvements.

title: Senior Manager, Partner Solution Architect
description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

  
  
  

Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).

  
  

**What you'll do**
------------------

  
  
  

As Senior Manager, Partner Solution Architects, you will lead and grow a team of Partner Success Architects (PSAs) based in our India Delivery Center, setting the technical direction, delivery standards, and career development path for the team. Your team is the technical backbone of our partner ecosystem, providing hands-on solution design, activation support, and delivery escalation expertise for our global network of Systems Integrator (SI) and Independent Software Vendor (ISV) Global Delivery Center personnel as Docusign’s in-region APJ partners. You will work cross-functionally with Americas, EMEA and AP partner and sales leadership, engineering, and the global Partner Success organization to make sure the right technical resources are deployed against the right priorities, and that every technical engagement ties back to a tangible, customer-facing partner deliverable.

This position is a people manager role reporting to the Senior Director, Value Delivery Activation.

**Responsibility**

* Lead, hire, coach, and develop a team of Partner Solution Architects in the India Delivery Center, setting technical quality standards, career paths, and performance expectations
* Own technical solutioning and technical delivery support for Docusign's APJ in-region teams, ensuring PSAs deliver timely, high-quality solution design, activation workshops, and delivery escalation support for partner-led engagements
* Own technical solutioning and technical delivery support for GDC resources across our Systems Integrator (SI) and Independent Software Vendor (ISV) network.
* Partner closely with in-region Partner Success and Sales leaders to align on ISV and SI enablement and delivery-support priorities, and ensure PSA resources are deployed in alignment with in-region business strategies and demand
* Define, document, and continuously refine team activities, engagement models, and playbooks, ensuring technical solutioning and technical delivery support connect directly to customer-facing partner deliverables
* Establish and report on agreed upon team KPIs (e.g., GDC pre-delivery assessment completion, nearshore delivery volume, GDC-to-onshore handoff SLAs, ISV/Builder enablement and activation velocity) to global Customer Success and Partner Success leadership
* Serve as the primary escalation point for complex technical issues raised by partner personnel, engaging Docusign engineering and product teams as needed
* Represent the Partner Success Architect function to internal stakeholders and partner organizations, championing consistent, scalable technical enablement practices

  

**Job Designation**
-------------------

  
  
  

**Hybrid:** Employee divides their time between in-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in-office expectation)

Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.

  
  

**What you bring**
------------------

  
  
  

**Basic**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 12+ years of experience in technical solutioning, solutions architecture, or technical delivery roles, including experience supporting partner or channel ecosystems
* 2+ years of people management experience, ideally leading technical or partner-facing teams
* Demonstrated experience working with Systems Integrators (SI) and/or Independent Software Vendors (ISV)
* Experience supporting or collaborating with global and regional delivery teams across time zones, including APJ

  
  

**Preferred**

* Experience building, managing, or scaling a Global Delivery Center (GDC) or nearshore/offshore technical delivery model
* Hands-on experience with Docusign IAM, CLM, eSignature, or agentic/AI-native solutions
* Experience with Salesforce.com
* Experience defining enablement programs, technical playbooks, or delivery frameworks for partner ecosystems
* Track record of aligning cross-regional stakeholders (APJ, EMEA, Americas) on shared technical enablement and delivery priorities
* Strong understanding of e-signature, contract lifecycle management (CLM), or intelligent agreement management technologies
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting to both technical and business audiences

  

**Life at Docusign**
--------------------

  
  
  

**Working here**

Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.

We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live.

The role contributes to, or leads, the development of solution architectures, prototypes and proofs of concept where required. It validates solution feasibility, delivery scope, resource requirements, effort estimates, commercial assumptions, delivery risks and contractual commitments before NTT DATA enters into a client agreement.
  
  
As part of the Global AI Delivery Unit, the role helps protect delivery outcomes and the AI Delivery PL by ensuring that proposed solutions have an appropriate delivery structure, cost-recovery model, risk position and transition plan before customer signature.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Deal intake and GTM interlock
  

* Act as the primary technical and delivery interlock for assigned AI opportunities from qualified intake through solution approval, contracting and handover to delivery.
* Engage with regional GTM, sales and solution teams early in the opportunity lifecycle to understand the client’s business problem, intended outcomes, technical environment, data landscape and commercial requirements.
* Assess whether the opportunity is sufficiently qualified for Global AI Delivery engagement and identify any additional information, discovery or customer validation required.
* Review use-case descriptions and business requirements to assess whether the proposed use of AI is appropriate, feasible and aligned with measurable client outcomes.
* Support structured discovery sessions with clients and internal stakeholders, translating business requirements into actionable technical and delivery requirements.
* Identify the specialist capabilities required to support the pursuit and coordinate targeted engagement from Global AI Delivery Unit, security, legal, commercial and regional delivery teams.
* Manage the involvement of delivery specialists carefully, ensuring that delivery expertise is used for material design decisions and specialist validation without drawing delivery teams unnecessarily into general pre-sales activity.
* Maintain clear communication with opportunity owners regarding solution status, outstanding decisions, risks, dependencies and readiness for assurance.

AI solution architecture and design
  

* Shape or own the end-to-end architecture of AI solutions across application, model, data, integration, infrastructure and security domains.
* Evaluate architecture options and select appropriate AI models, cloud services, orchestration frameworks and third-party technologies, balancing cost, performance, scalability, security and delivery complexity.
* Define secure integration, functional and non-functional requirements, data governance and responsible AI requirements for the proposed solution.
* Align solutions with NTT DATA reference architectures, reusable assets, delivery patterns and approved technology standards.

Prototyping and feasibility validation
  

* Develop, lead or coordinate prototypes and proofs of concept where required to validate feasibility, reduce delivery risk or demonstrate the proposed solution.
* Test material assumptions relating to model performance, data, integration, security, scalability, latency and consumption cost, with clear success and exit criteria.
* Translate prototype findings into the production architecture, estimate, assumptions and risk position, engaging specialist engineering support where required.

Delivery planning and resource model
  

* Translate the solution into a realistic delivery approach covering workstreams, deliverables, milestones, dependencies and mobilisation.
* Define or validate the resource model, effort estimates, skills, location strategy and use of global delivery centres, partners or subcontractors.
* Assess delivery timelines and define appropriate governance, roles, responsibilities, escalation and change control.
* Identify requirements for managed services, production support, model monitoring, platform operations or continuous optimisation where applicable.

Commercial solution development
  

* Work with commercial, finance, sales and delivery stakeholders to develop a commercial construct aligned to the architecture and delivery model.
* Validate estimates, rate-card assumptions, third-party costs, consumption charges and contingency, ensuring all material delivery costs are represented.
* Ensure the resource model, delivery estimate, pricing, contribution and margin assumptions remain internally consistent, with uncertainty managed through appropriate commercial mechanisms.
* Support pricing and approval processes and challenge commercial constructs that create unmanageable technical or delivery risk for NTT DATA.

Scope and statement-of-work development
  

* Support the drafting and review of proposals and statements of work, defining scope, deliverables, milestones, assumptions, exclusions, dependencies, client responsibilities and acceptance criteria.
* Ensure contractual artefacts accurately reflect the approved architecture, delivery approach, resource plan and commercial model, without ambiguous or unbounded commitments.
* Coordinate legal, security, data protection and responsible AI input and support negotiation of technical and delivery-related contractual terms.

Deal assurance and governance
  

* Assess the completeness and quality of the proposed solution across architecture, technical feasibility, delivery readiness, resource requirements, commercial consistency and risk treatment.
* Identify material technical, data, security, privacy, legal, commercial and delivery risks and ensure appropriate owners and mitigations are in place.
* Prepare and present assigned opportunities for relevant assurance and approval gates, coordinating required stakeholder review and sign-off.
* Provide a clear, evidence-based assurance recommendation: proceed, proceed subject to conditions, return for rework or do not proceed in the proposed form.
* Track assurance conditions, escalate material concerns and maintain appropriate decision records; ensure independent review where the architect has materially developed the solution.

Transition and handover to delivery
  

* Maintain a controlled solution baseline through contracting and mobilisation, ensuring material changes are reflected consistently across deal artefacts.
* Lead the transition to delivery, providing the approved architecture, scope, commercial baseline, resource plan, assumptions, dependencies, risks and client commitments.
* Support early mobilisation, resolve gaps between what was sold and what is being delivered, and capture feedback to improve future solutioning and estimates.

Reuse and capability development
  

* Contribute reusable AI architectures, delivery patterns, prototypes, estimation models, proposal assets and commercial assumptions informed by pursuit and delivery experience.
* Share knowledge, coach regional teams and continuously improve the methods, templates and governance controls used by the AI Deal Intake, Assurance Governance function.

Knowledge and Attributes
  

* Advanced enterprise solution architecture knowledge across application, integration, data, infrastructure, cloud and security domains.
* Strong understanding of AI, generative AI and agentic AI solution patterns, including model selection and evaluation, RAG, prompting, grounding, data pipelines, APIs and vector databases.
* Strong knowledge of major cloud platforms and their AI, data, integration and security capabilities, with working knowledge of software engineering, DevOps, MLOps and LLMOps.
* Ability to develop or lead prototypes and assess the path from proof of concept to a secure, scalable and supportable production solution.
* Strong understanding of security, privacy, compliance, data governance and responsible AI considerations.
* Commercial acumen across estimates, rate cards, pricing models, third-party costs, contribution, margin, contingency and cost recovery.
* Understanding of statements of work, contractual assumptions, acceptance criteria, client dependencies, change control and delivery transition.
* Strong client-facing consulting, communication and stakeholder-management skills across technical, commercial, delivery and executive audiences.
* Ability to exercise constructive challenge, make evidence-based decisions and manage multiple complex opportunities under demanding pursuit timelines.
* Strong analytical capability and attention to detail when reviewing solution, commercial and contractual artefacts.

Academic Qualifications and Certifications
  

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience in computer science, engineering, data science, information systems, business or a related field.
* Relevant cloud or AI certification from Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services or Google Cloud Platform is preferred.
* Enterprise or solution architecture certification such as TOGAF is advantageous; additional AI, security, privacy, agile, project or service-management certifications are beneficial.

Ideal / Desired Experience

title: Vulnerability Management Analyst — Semiconductor IP
description:
**Date posted** 10/11/2026

### **Category** **Engineering****Hire Type** **Employee****Job ID** **19196****Remote Eligible** **No****Date Posted** **10/11/2026**

**Vulnerability Management Analyst - Semiconductor IP**

**We Are:**

At Synopsys, we drive the innovations that shape the way we live and connect. Our technology is central to the Era of Pervasive Intelligence, from self-driving cars to learning machines. We lead in chip design, verification, and IP integration, empowering the creation of high-performance silicon chips and software content. Join us to transform the future through continuous technological innovation.

**You Are:**

You are someone who builds trust with product and engineering teams when the topic is risk. You listen first, explain complex findings in clear language, and own your conclusions. You help people understand what a vulnerability means for their work and what they should do next.

You are practical when information is incomplete. You stay focused on timely action, challenge unclear choices in a respectful way, and keep looking for better ways to reduce risk. You care about teamwork, follow-through, and leaving guidance that others can use.

This is a full-time role.

**What You’ll Be Doing:**

* Analyze vulnerabilities affecting semiconductor IP products, firmware, and related interfaces, and determine residual risk with clear assumptions.
* Prioritize findings so product teams can act in a timely way: severity, exploitability, affected assets, and recommended mitigations.
* Work with design, verification, firmware, and product teams to explain vulnerabilities, walk through impact, and agree how the team will mitigate.
* Advise those teams on practical mitigations, compensating controls, and verification or test evidence that shows the risk is reduced.
* Work in semiconductor IP development and associated test flows, using the tools those teams use to design, verify, and test IP, so analysis matches how the product is actually built.
* Build and maintain your own analysis, intake, scoring, and reporting tools, including in Python, when existing tools are not enough. Scripts and tools should be readable and usable by other analysts.
* Track open risk through the cybersecurity lifecycle, from intake through analysis, treatment, verification, and internal release decisions, and keep status current.
* Facilitate working sessions so similar IP classes get consistent analysis, risk language, and mitigation guidance.
* Look for new and practical ways to detect, assess, and mitigate risk, including improved methods, automation, and lessons from prior findings.
* Use agentic workflows (AI agents, structured prompts, and human-in-the-loop review) to speed research and first drafts without handing off ownership of risk conclusions.
* Run the job in Jira, Confluence, Git, and GitLab: track vulnerability and risk work, keep documentation current, and version work products through review.

**The Impact You Will Have:**

* Give product teams vulnerability analysis and risk determinations they can trust and act on without re-deriving the work.
* Reduce time-to-mitigation by explaining findings clearly and agreeing practical next steps with the teams that own the product.
* Leave mitigation and test guidance that design, verification, and firmware teams can execute.
* Keep residual risk visible and current so internal release and treatment decisions are based on evidence, not stale status.
* Improve consistency of vulnerability handling and risk language across similar IP classes.
* Raise the quality of risk reduction over time by bringing new methods, better mitigations, and fit-for-purpose tools into the workflow.

**What You’ll Need:**

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, computer science, cybersecurity, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. An advanced degree is welcome, not required.
* Typically 3 or more years in vulnerability management, product cybersecurity, embedded security, or a closely related engineering role. Stronger evidence on vulnerability analysis and risk determination can offset fewer years. Title (Analyst or Senior Analyst) will match demonstrated depth.
* Strong practical experience in vulnerability analysis on real products, not only scanning or training exercises.
* Ability to determine risk: severity, exploitability, affected assets, likelihood, impact, and residual risk after proposed mitigations.
* Ability to explain vulnerabilities and recommended mitigations to engineering teams so they can act in a timelyway.
* Working familiarity with semiconductor IP development and associated testing, including the tools used to design, verify, and test IP. Specific commercial tool names are not required.
* Ability to write and maintain your own tools, including in Python, for analysis, intake, scoring, and reporting when existing tools are not enough. This is not a software-engineering role. Tools should be readable and usable by other analysts.
* Experience working with incomplete information and stating assumptions when the end-system is not fully known.
Experience* ing a cybersecurity lifecycle across planning, design, implementation, verification, and internal release, including tracking open risk to closure.
* Hands-on understanding of embedded systems enough to reason about hardware-rooted and firmware vulnerabilities: SoC or MCU integration, firmware, interfaces, registers, boot and debug, and interconnects.
* Experience delivering analysis inside product-team cadence, including re-prioritizing when new findings or design changes arrive.
* Practical experience using AI agents and agentic workflows to speed research, drafting, and repetitive analysis, while keeping the human as owner of technical conclusions.

* Hands-on use of Jira, Confluence, Git, and GitLab (or an equivalent Git forge) for tickets, documentation, and review.
* Clear written and spoken English; able to lead technical sessions with geographically distributed teams.
* Working knowledge of common vulnerability scoring and handling practice (for example CVSS) is helpful, as is ISO/SAE 21434 or a comparable product-cybersecurity standard, digital design or verification background (including RTL), semiconductor IP product experience, or applied embedded cryptography.

**Who You Are:**

* You build trust with design and product teams and keep working relationships strong when the discussion is about risk.
* You own the technical conclusion. You do not hand off judgment to a scanner, a score, a tool, or the loudest voice in the room.
* You write and speak clearly so engineers can understand a vulnerability and how to mitigate it without you in the room.
* You work well with incomplete information, and you state assumptions instead of hiding them.
* You drive timely action. You keep risk visible until it is treated or accepted with a clear rationale.
* You challenge unclear practices in a respectful way and recommend mitigations teams can actually adopt.
* You keep learning. You look for new and practical ways to assess and reduce risk, not only the methods you already know.
* You are collaborative and non-disruptive with product teams, including when you need them to change course.
* You are structured and detail-oriented, and you keep evidence current as findings and designs change.

**The Team You’ll Be** **A** **Part Of:**

You will join the CySec Vulnerability Management Team that supports Synopsys semiconductor IP products. You work with IP product teams in their delivery cadence. You collaborate with digital, analog, mixed-signal, firmware, and verification engineers, and with cybersecurity architects, to analyze vulnerabilities, determine risk, and agree mitigations through the cybersecurity lifecycle. The team works across regions. Your written work products are used by internal product and engineering teams.

**Rewards and Benefits:**

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.
